verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.
verses.pt: Louvai ao Senhor. Louvai o nome do Senhor; louvai-o, servos do Senhor,
verses.en_web: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,
verses.en_bbe: Let the Lord be praised. O you servants of the Lord, give praise to the name of the Lord.

verses.en: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,
verses.pt: vós que assistis na casa do Senhor, nos átrios da casa do nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
verses.en_bbe: You who are in the house of the Lord, and in the open spaces of the house of our God,

verses.en: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.pt: Louvai ao Senhor, porque o Senhor é bom; cantai louvores ao seu nome, porque ele é bondoso.
verses.en_web: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to Jah, for he is good: make melody to his name, for it is pleasing.

verses.en: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor escolheu para si a Jacó, e a Israel para seu tesouro peculiar.
verses.en_web: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself; Israel for his own possession.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord has taken Jacob for himself, and Israel for his property.

verses.en: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.pt: Porque eu conheço que o Senhor é grande e que o nosso Senhor está acima de todos os deuses.
verses.en_web: For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.en_bbe: I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is greater than all other gods.

verses.en: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
verses.pt: Tudo o que o Senhor deseja ele o faz, no céu e na terra, nos mares e em todos os abismos.
verses.en_web: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has done whatever was pleasing to him, in heaven, and on the earth, in the seas and in all the deep waters.

verses.en: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
verses.pt: Faz subir os vapores das extremidades da terra; faz os relâmpagos para a chuva; tira os ventos dos seus tesouros.
verses.en_web: who causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth; who makes lightnings with the rain; who brings the wind out of his treasuries;
verses.en_bbe: He makes the mists go up from the ends of the earth; he makes thunder-flames for the rain; he sends out the winds from his store-houses.

verses.en: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
verses.pt: Foi ele que feriu os primogênitos do Egito, desde os homens até os animais;
verses.en_web: Who struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal;
verses.en_bbe: He put to death the first-fruits of Egypt, of man and of beast.

verses.en: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
verses.pt: que operou sinais e prodígios no meio de ti, ó Egito, contra Faraó e contra os seus servos;
verses.en_web: Who sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants;
verses.en_bbe: He sent signs and wonders among you, O Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

verses.en: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
verses.pt: que feriu muitas nações, e matou reis poderosos:
verses.en_web: who struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
verses.en_bbe: He overcame great nations, and put strong kings to death;

verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
verses.pt: a Siom, rei dos amorreus, e a Ogue, rei de Basã, e a todos os reinos de Canaã;
verses.en_web: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
verses.en_bbe: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;

verses.en: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
verses.pt: e deu a terra deles em herança, em herança a Israel, seu povo.
verses.en_web: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
verses.en_bbe: And gave their land for a heritage, even for a heritage to Israel his people.

verses.en: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
verses.pt: O teu nome, ó Senhor, subsiste para sempre; e a tua memória, ó Senhor, por todas as gerações.
verses.en_web: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, your name is eternal; and the memory of you will have no end.

verses.en: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.pt: Pois o Senhor julgará o seu povo, e se compadecerá dos seus servos.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord will be judge of his people's cause; his feelings will be changed to his servants.

verses.en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.pt: Os ídolos das nações são prata e ouro, obra das mãos dos homens;
verses.en_web: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.en_bbe: The images of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.pt: têm boca, mas não falam; têm olhos, mas não vêem;
verses.en_web: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
verses.en_bbe: They have mouths, but no voice, they have eyes, but they do not see;

verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.pt: têm ouvidos, mas não ouvem; nem há sopro algum na sua boca.
verses.en_web: They have ears, but they can’t hear; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.en_bbe: They have ears, but no hearing; and there is no breath in their mouths.

verses.en: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.pt: Semelhantemente a eles se tornarão os que os fazem, e todos os que neles confiam.
verses.en_web: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
verses.en_bbe: Those who make them are like them; and so is everyone who puts his hope in them.

verses.en: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:
verses.pt: Ó casa de Israel, bendizei ao Senhor; ó casa de Arão, bendizei ao Senhor;
verses.en_web: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord, O children of Israel: give praise to the Lord, O sons of Aaron:

verses.en: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
verses.pt: ó casa de Levi, bendizei ao Senhor; vós, os que temeis ao Senhor, bendizei ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord, O sons of Levi: let all the worshippers of the Lord give him praise.

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: Desde Sião seja bendito o Senhor, que habita em Jerusalém. Louvai ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, Who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: Praise be to the Lord out of Zion, even to the Lord whose house is in Jerusalem, Let the Lord be praised.
